Increased Damage Taken |sandbox = Yes |tag = {{AttrTag|Second|NeuralyzedIcon.png|Neuralyzed}} }} ==Description== '''Neuralyzed''' is a status effect that can be used to force towers to target enemies and increase their damage taken. It is applied by the [[Saboteur]]'s ''Aggressive Toxins'' ability at Level 3+. ==Mechanics== '''Neuralyzed''', when applied, will create a pale green aura around the hit enemy and force towers to target them, prioritizing enemies with '''Neuralyzed''' over enemies with [[Aggro]]. It will also increase the damage an enemy takes by a certain percentage. ==Enemy List== Any enemy hit by the [[Saboteur]]'s ''Aggressive Toxins'' ability can have this status effect applied onto it. Currently, no enemies can spawn naturally with this status effect or spawn with it applied as it is meant to be a debuff. ==Update History== *'''22 April 2026''' - [[v1.89.0]] **'''Neuralyzed''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Neuralyzed''' rounds up damage instead of rounding it down. *'''19 June 2026''' - [[v2.1.0]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Neuralyzed''' now rounds down damage. {{AttributeNavBox}}
